description: CorpusIQ connects ChatGPT to the business systems you already use, including analytics, advertising, commerce, CRM, email, calendars, documents, and operational platforms. Ask questions such as “how did our ads do last month,” “show me overdue invoices,” or “compare email revenue to ad spend,” and CorpusIQ retrieves data from your connected accounts with source-aware results. The ChatGPT catalog retains the full customer-facing connector and runbook experience, except for generic database and ODBC tools that accept arbitrary connection targets, credentials, or query text. Connected-service retrieval is read-only unless a tool is explicitly annotated as state-changing; CorpusIQ account settings and canonical records use explicit, user-directed operations.
